name: @cubiczan/resilience
description: Git-install shim for @cubiczan/resilience — makes the repo root installable via `npm/bun install github:icohangar-ops/cubiczan-resilience#typescript-vX.Y.Z`. The publishable package (and the real manifest) lives in typescript/; see PUBLISH.md. Keep this version in lockstep with typescript/package.json.
author: Shyam Desigan <sam@cubiczan.com>

scripts.prepare: cd typescript && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
